description: Marks a stored fact as no longer valid. Use this when the user corrects a fact, says something has changed, or explicitly asks to forget something. Does NOT delete the fact -- preserves history. Requires the fact_id from a prior save_fact or search_memory result. Do NOT use for new information -- use save_fact instead.

fact_id.description: UUID of the fact to invalidate

reason.description: Why the fact is no longer valid (optional but recommended)

session_id.description: Current session ID for the audit log

name: invalidate_fact
title: Invalidate a fact
